title: Good Girl Presented with Murder Bury Win
program: Night of the Dead Dead Shorts
description: A professional dog walker, immersed in a self- help podcast, finds herself in very dangerous territory. Sat at home in his basement, spreading misinformation across social media, an Internet-troll gets more than he bargained for when he is trolled by a real troll. Young adults Haruka, Nana, and Takanori visit their friend Souta, whom they’ve not heard from for a while, only to find his house in a mess and his behaviour a little strange.
